text:
incidents-bot: PAGER: High 5xx spike and latency from cross-region routing. Affected regions: eu-west1 -> ap-southeast1 traffic appears misrouted. Start: 2026-03-15T14:46:29Z. Alerts: 5xx rate +1200% last 5m. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/incident/5043216789 :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): on it. can someone triage routing policy changes in the last 10m? I'll notify CS and page kevin.

kevin (ops-lead): acked. coming in. maria, do we have a quick customer impact estimate? (error %, top customers)

maria (oncall): quick look: errors concentrated on routes pinned to eu-west1 origin set. approx 12% of requests hitting eu-west are getting 503s or 502s and ~18% of cross-region flows see latency >1200ms. tentative customer impact: a handful of high-traffic tenants showing 5xx and timeouts.

patrick (sre): looking at router logs now. seems like a routing policy operator slipped a new weighting rule that favored ap-southeast for eu-west-origined traffic. here's a grep of the policy changes:```
2026-03-15T14:39:02Z PUT /routing/policy/geo-weighting {"eu-west1":0.2,"ap-southeast1":0.8} by svc-deploy
2026-03-15T14:39:05Z controller-applier applyID=op-8812
```

patrick (sre): and the router decision trace for a sample request:```trace_id=tx-9a1b
client_region=eu-west1
route_lookup=policy:geo-weighting
selected_region=ap-southeast1
kv_cache=mismatch:region_pin=true
result=proxy->ap-southeast1 (failed 502)```

kevin (ops-lead): that matches reports. new weighting favored ap-southeast for eu-west origin — bug. we need a mitigation path: 1) temporarily revert geo-weighting to previous values 2) pin eu-west1 for eu-west origin routes until stable 3) roll back problematic deploy. who can run revert?

eve (deploy-bot): @kevin I can run a rollback patch to routing config if you approve. current commit: commit-id=ab12c9. rollback candidate: commit-id=ab12b3. Dry-run available.

maria (oncall): do it. priority=high. include canary 5% then 50% then full. monitor 1m buckets. CS messaging: @customersuccess-bot prepare a short note for impacted customers.

eve (deploy-bot): executing rollback (dry-run first) -> ```
curl -XPOST https://control.plane/routing/rollback -d '{"target_commit":"ab12b3","canary":0.05}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTING_TOKEN"
```

incidents-bot: Deploy job queued: job=rollback-ab12b3 canary=5% started by eve at 2026-03-15T14:49:10Z. Watch: https://ci.redwood/jobs/rollback-ab12b3

patrick (sre): while rollback is running i'm applying a temporary policy override to pin origin eu-west1 -> eu-west1. small API call:```
PATCH /routing/overrides/5043216789
payload:
- path: "/policies/geo-weighting/eu-west1"
  op: replace
  value: {"force_pin":true}
```

patrick (sre): applied override. routing traces now show selection eu-west1 for sampled requests. checking error stream...

maria (oncall): monitoring: 5xx rate dropping in eu-west from 12% -> 3% over 2m. latency tail still elevated for cross-region inflight requests. good sign.

customersuccess-bot: Notified top-10 impacted accounts with preliminary message: "We are mitigating a routing issue causing elevated errors/latency for some EU traffic. Our engineering team is reverting a routing config and applying safeguards. We'll follow up with ETA and root cause." Will prepare FAQ for support.

kevin (ops-lead): great. keep rollback canary at 5% for 3m then ramp to 50% if stable. patrick keep the pin in place until we confirm healthy redistributions. once stable we'll coordinate a staged rollback of the operator change and force a full policy audit.

eve (deploy-bot): canary passed 3m, no new 5xx in canary -> ramping to 50% now.```eve logs: rollback-ab12b3:phase=canary50 started at 2026-03-15T14:56:40Z```

patrick (sre): telemetry update: overall cross-region 95th p50 latency down from 1800ms -> 420ms after pin + rollback canary. 5xx at global level reduced to 0.9% from 2.7%.

maria (oncall): paging followup: oncall transfer to Kevin in 10m for deeper root cause and postmortem lead. tagging kevin as incident lead.

kevin (ops-lead): noted. i'll take lead after handoff. immediate next actions: - keep pin active until full rollback completes - start remediation playbook to prevent operator-initiated weight flips without multi-sig - prepare customer postmortem draft with CS.

patrick (sre): quick note on root cause hypothesis: operator GUI allowed an incremental apply that didn't validate inter-region affinity constraints; a race with autoscaler may have caused temporary capacity drop in eu-west and policy shifted weights as a fallback. need to check controller logs around 14:38-14:41.

customersuccess-bot: CS message updated and sent to affected customers. Suggested external status: "Degraded: routing misconfiguration causing errors for EU-origin traffic — mitigation in progress, service performance improving."

incidents-bot: status: Mitigated -> partial (rollback underway, pins applied). Next update in 15m or on-call handoff.

maria (oncall): handing off to kevin now for root cause + postmortem. I'll remain on stand-by for any regressions.

kevin (ops-lead): taking over. will coordinate with platform to schedule forced rollout of validated policy and require operator multi-sig. assigning postmortem to patrick and maria. timeline: preliminary RCA by EOD, full postmortem next business day.

patrick (sre): confirming I'll own RCA with maria. note: leave controller traces preserved: /var/log/router/controller/trace-5043216789*.zip

eve (deploy-bot): rollback completed to commit ab12b3 at 2026-03-15T15:02:03Z. Full rollout successful. Monitoring: 5xx at baseline, latency tail normalized.

incidents-bot: RESOLVED -> mitigation complete at 2026-03-15T15:05:23Z. Summary: routing policy operator change caused unintended geo-weighting that misrouted eu-west traffic to ap-southeast, resulting in elevated 5xx and latency. Mitigation: rollback + temporary pin + operator workflow fixes planned. Postmortem assigned.

kevin (ops-lead): closing the pager. please add any leftover notes here and open a follow-up ticket for policy UI guardrails. :white_check_mark:
